snippet.title: Aegis Of Kings | Monster Armies & Kingdom Conquest | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
If you'd like to support us please wish list our game on the store page! It's the best way to support us!
Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4507180/Aegis_Of_Kings/

Lead your kingdom to victory in this sandbox grand strategy RPG. Command heroes and monsters, capture castles, and customize your forces to your needs. Fight for the Aegis solo, join friends in co-op, or face rivals head-to-head.
